mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.account (account_number, customer_id, account_type_id, branch_id, status, last_transaction_at) VALUES (nextval('app.account_number_seq')::text, #{customerId}, #{accountTypeId}, #{branchId}, 'PENDING_OPEN', #{lastTransactionAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.account_type WHERE id = #{accountTypeId})
SELECT status FROM app.account WHERE id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE app.account SET status = #{status}, opened_at = CASE WHEN #{activating} AND opened_at IS NULL THEN #{today} ELSE opened_at END, last_transaction_at = CASE WHEN #{activating} AND opened_at IS NULL THEN #{today} ELSE last_transaction_at END, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{closing} THEN #{today} ELSE closed_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.account_status_history (account_id, from_status, to_status, ticket_id, changed_by) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{ticketId}, #{changedBy})
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.account_number, a.customer_id, c.full_name AS customer_name, c.cccd AS customer_cccd, t.name AS account_type_name, b.name AS branch_name, a.status, a.opened_at, a.closed_at, a.last_transaction_at, open_ticket.code AS open_ticket_code, open_ticket.type AS open_ticket_type, open_ticket.status AS open_ticket_status FROM app.account a JOIN app.customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id JOIN app.account_type t ON t.id = a.account_type_id JOIN app.branch b ON b.id = a.branch_id LEFT JOIN app.ticket open_ticket ON open_ticket.account_id = a.id AND open_ticket.status IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
